cohort: Preterm infants admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) at Bench Sheko, Kafa, and Sheka hospitals between March and September 2020.
finding: The prevalence of neonatal hypothermia was 62.9% and was associated with antenatal care visits, obstetric complications during delivery, caesarian section delivery, non-vertex presentation, 5-min APGAR score <7, practicing kangaroo mother care, and initiation of breastfeeding between 1 and 2 hours.
mod_finding: Caesarian section delivery was associated with neonatal hypothermia (AOR: 1.91; 95%CI: 0.740-4.96).
